name: Bukidnon Speedcubing Challenge 2017

venue.name: Bukidnon Breeze Seafood Restaurant and Events Venue, Fortich Street, Sumpong, Malaybalay City, Bukidnon
venue.address: Bukidnon Breeze Seafood Restaurant and Events Venue, Fortich Street, Sumpong, Malaybalay City, Bukidnon
venue.details: Event area In front of the restaurant.

information: This competition is a sports based event dedicated to help the youth towards a healthy and brighter future. It is also the very first ever WCA competition in the city of Malaybalay Bukidnon. It is open to all Filipinos and Foreign Speedcubers.
